rationale: Programme sub-page of the EU Funding & Tenders Portal already covered by the parent portal; weak vendor/competitor signal for CZ A6.
Standalone EU open-data platform but macro funding sizing only — marginal for identifying CZ payment vendors.
Standalone national RRF portal whose digitalisation milestones flag upcoming public payments/IT procurement.
Ministry programme section on gov.cz with many siblings; supplier-selection rules are useful context, not a standalone signal feed.
National procurement bulletin — primary, continuously producing source naming CZ banking/payments buyers and awarded vendors.
Bulk open-data endpoint enabling vendor win-share analysis across payments CPV classes; machine-readable and durable.
Live national e-procurement platform carrying technical specs and awards that expose incumbent vendor lock-in.
Valuable normalised CZ tender analytics layer, but url_verification failed and licensing is unclear — recheck liveness before approving.
Certified profil zadavatele host — mine once to enumerate payments-relevant public buyers, then archive.
State Treasury page naming public-sector payment gateway and card-terminal arrangements — direct incumbent-acquirer intelligence.
Single authority document repository cited for one terminal-operation tender PDF; evidence and a search template, not a monitored feed.
Statutory register plus Sbírka listin filings — primary financial and ownership evidence on CZ payment vendors and PSPs.
Advanced-search front-end enabling population-level screening of CZ payment/IT vendors by activity and officers.
Bulk register dumps — the machine-readable backbone for a persistent CZ vendor actor map.
Canonical entity resolver with REST API and NACE enumeration; joins every other CZ filing source.
Authoritative beneficial-ownership data but public access closed since Dec 2025 — a human must clear legitimate-interest access.
ČNB licence registers with web services — defines the licensed CZ PSP/e-money competitor universe.
Statutory contract register with open-data API — hard evidence of vendor wins and contract values with public and state-linked entities.
Insolvency register gives distress signals and creditor-derived customer maps for vendors and fintech competitors.
Official gazette event feed on liquidations and capital changes; coverage partly migrated post-2024 so value is secondary.
Commercial credit-bureau profiles are a fast comparable scorecard but registration/subscription and ToS must be cleared first.
Free register aggregator with ownership graphs — efficient snowballing from a payments vendor to its group, though secondary to justice.cz.
Third register mirror largely redundant with justice.cz and kurzy.cz; keep only as an ambiguity cross-check.
Low-credibility aggregator with derived estimates; unverified revenue proxies risk polluting the registry.
BRIS is a cross-border register pointer with basic data only — use to route from CZ subsidiaries to foreign parents, not to monitor.
Free bulk LEI Level-2 parent relationships give a machine-readable group skeleton for CZ banks and PSPs.
Free UK register with full-text filing search and API; UK-parented payment vendors disclose CEE segment detail absent from CZ accounts.
DACH parent filings name Czech subsidiaries, but much of the register is paywalled/registration-gated — confirm free-access scope.
